messages:
marta: Quick sync — final checklist for Integr8 marketplace listing + joint GTM. Need owners for: publish choreography, embargo list, landing hero, partner assets, and post-launch telemetry. Who can own what?

alex: I will own publish choreography + CDN invalidation steps. Will schedule a 15m publish window Fri.

jess: Partner assets (logo + quote). Got a partial SVG from Integr8, chasing final alt text and trademark line.

nate: Telemetry: will add partner_id and utm scheme, plus GA4 events for marketplace_click and partner_lead. Doing sample dashboard tiles.

leah: Embargo handling and press contacts. Need final embargo list by Wed EOD to route to legal. legal-bot, estimate?

legal-bot: Standard embargo review; ETA 24 hours once list is submitted. If urgent, tag ticket with `priority-embargo`.

ops-bot: Publish window reservation: 2025-06-13T16:00:00Z - 2025-06-13T16:15:00Z. Noted dry-run on Thu.

marta: Summary actions: alex (publish choreography), jess (final assets), nate (telemetry), leah (embargo). Risks: hero image license or delayed quote — fallback to quote-first blog publish. Everyone ok?

participants: reactions? :thumbsup:
